Fernando is a soil sensor that texts you, in your plant's voice, when it needs water or light. It
costs ***. Would you buy one? Be honest.
Forty-nine bucks is a week of groceries for me, so not
alone. But if my roommates split it? Probably yes.
We're all killing the same pothos.
> Have you split the cost of something for the
apartment before? How did that go?
Yeah, we Venmo'd for an air fryer in September. Took
three weeks to collect, but we did it. A plant that
roasts us in the group chat would sell itself to them.
I'd think about it as a gift, but three dollars a
month means I'm gifting someone a bill. That feels

Gerald. Fiddle leaf fig. I had an alarm for him and
